exceptions.reason: The advisory covers only MSAL Node's authorization code flow (acquireTokenByCode). The backend reaches msal-node solely through @azure/identity's DefaultAzureCredential (blob storage and Content Safety), which in the containers authenticates with a client secret and never runs the auth code flow; no code calls acquireTokenByCode or AuthorizationCodeCredential. No in-range fix exists: the fix is msal-node 7.1.0, but @azure/identity 4.14.0, the latest, and its 4.15 beta both require msal-node ^6, and an override would force an undeclared major under it.
exceptions.exitCriterion: @azure/identity depends on @azure/msal-node 7.1.0 or later; then update it and remove this entry.
